title: Tilda
body:
<<if $bridgeDown == true>>
I heard the bridge. He liked the pie then.
<<elseif $hasPie == true>>
Bless you. Don't eat it on the way.
<<else>>
Bram forgot his lunch again. He gets impossible when he's hungry.
Would you take him this pie? It's still warm.
[[Take the pie to Bram|TildaTakePie]]
[[Not right now|TildaNotNow]]
<<end>>

title: TildaTakePie
body:
<<set $hasPie = true>>
Bless you. Don't eat it on the way.

title: TildaNotNow
body: It won't stay warm forever. Neither will Bram's patience.

title: Bram
body:
<<if $bridgeDown == true>>
Best bridge keeper in the valley. When fed.
<<elseif $hasPie == true>>
Is that Tilda's pie? Why didn't you say so!
<<set $bridgeDown = true>>
<<lowerBridge>>
Stand back. Bridge coming down. Mind your toes.
<<else>>
The bridge stays up. I don't lower bridges on an empty stomach.
<<end>>

title: Pip
body:
<<if $bridgeDown == true>>
You got Bram his pie? Now he'll nap till supper.
<<else>>
Bram's been grumpy since breakfast. He didn't have breakfast.
<<end>>
